label: Bible Study
prompt: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our _____; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
note: A prayer of surrender — we're the clay, and the potter is also our Father.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our _____ into the way of peace.
verse: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
note: Zacharias, silent for months, gets his voice back and sings of a light that will guide our feet into peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto _____: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verse: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
note: John's view of heaven's throne room includes a sea of glass, clear as crystal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For bodily _____ profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verse: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
note: Paul isn't anti-gym — bodily exercise profits a little; godliness pays dividends now and forever.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God _____.
verse: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
note: After losing everything in one day, Job worshipped: 'In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.'
